startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Required. Array of objects, e.g. [{"url":"https://example.com/product/1"}]. Each page is read and turned into one JSON row by AI.

instructions.title: Instructions (what to extract)
instructions.description: What to extract, in plain words, e.g. "product name, price, currency and whether it is in stock". Give instructions, a jsonSchema, or both; the run stops with a clear error if both are empty.
instructions.prefill: Extract the book title, price as a number, currency code, whether it is in stock, star rating (1-5) and the product description.

jsonSchema.title: JSON schema (output shape)
jsonSchema.description: Optional. A JSON Schema for the 'data' field of each row, or a shorthand like {"title":"string","price":"number","tags":"string[]"}. Output is validated against it; pages that don't match are retried, then returned as invalid_output and not charged.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Crawl depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: 0 = only the start URLs. 1 = also pages linked from them, and so on.

maxPages.title: Max pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages (default 20). AI agents: keep ≤10 for answers within ~45s. The free plan with the built-in AI processes up to 25 pages per run.

sameDomainOnly.title: Stay on the same website
sameDomainOnly.description: Only follow links to the start URLs' domains.

includeUrlPatterns.title: Only follow URLs matching
includeUrlPatterns.description: Regular expressions; when set, crawled links must match at least one (e.g. /catalogue/). Start URLs are always processed.

excludeUrlPatterns.title: Never follow URLs matching
excludeUrlPatterns.description: Regular expressions for links to skip (e.g. /login|/cart).

contentSelector.title: Content CSS selector
contentSelector.description: Optional. Send only this part of the page to the AI (e.g. main, #content, .product). Saves tokens and improves accuracy.

removeSelectors.title: Remove CSS selectors
removeSelectors.description: Optional comma-separated selectors to strip before extraction (e.g. .reviews, .related-products). Navigation, footers, scripts, cookie banners and ads are removed automatically.

keepHeaderFooter.title: Keep header, nav and footer
keepHeaderFooter.description: Turn on if the data you need lives in the header or footer (e.g. company address).

includeMarkdown.title: Include page markdown in output
includeMarkdown.description: Add the cleaned markdown sent to the AI to each row (useful for RAG or debugging).

maxInputTokensPerPage.title: Max input tokens per page
maxInputTokensPerPage.description: Longer pages are trimmed to this size (≈4 characters per token). Built-in AI: up to 16,000.

maxOutputTokensPerPage.title: Max output tokens per page
maxOutputTokensPerPage.description: Upper limit on the AI answer per page. Raise for pages with long lists. Built-in AI: up to 4,000.

llmApiKey.title: Your AI API key (optional)
llmApiKey.description: Leave empty to use the built-in AI (included in the price). Add your own OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, OpenRouter or Together key to pay the provider directly and get the lower own-key price. Stored encrypted.

llmProvider.title: AI provider (own key)
llmProvider.description: Provider of your own llmApiKey (ignored when using the built-in AI): openai, anthropic, gemini, deepseek, groq, openrouter, together, or openai-compatible with llmBaseUrl.

llmModel.title: AI model (own key)
llmModel.description: Optional. Defaults: OpenAI gpt-6-luna, Anthropic claude-haiku-5-5, Gemini gemini-3.1-flash-lite, DeepSeek deepseek-flash, Groq openai/gpt-oss-20b.

llmBaseUrl.title: AI API base URL (own key)
llmBaseUrl.description: Only for 'Other OpenAI-compatible API', e.g. https://api.example.com/v1

maxAiCostUsd.title: Max AI spend on your key (USD)
maxAiCostUsd.description: Optional. Stops the run once the estimated cost on your own key reaches this amount.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: Pages processed at the same time. Requests to one website are spaced out politely regardless.

maxRetries.title: Retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for failed page loads and AI calls.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds to wait for each page to load before giving up (default 30).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use Apify Proxy if a site blocks datacenter requests.
